name: Material laboratory / a precise kind of feeling
art: This scene is native HTML/CSS/SVG. Preserve the layered control construction and meaningful local data model rather than using a screenshot of a dashboard.

properties.label: Dense continuous instrument console
properties.text: Set a disciplined dark console beneath a technical heading. Fit a large response plot, physical knobs, illumination switch, state selector and distribution meter into distinct module shapes on one continuous grid.

properties.label: Different evidence in every module
properties.text: Give each module useful distinct anatomy: a response plot, setpoints, radial ticks, modes and distribution evidence. Use honest units or explicitly relative values rather than decorative pseudo-telemetry.

properties.label: Machined anthracite instrument panels
properties.text: Use anthracite-green planes, crisp inset borders, restrained bevels, directional surface light and machined knob faces, with tiny warm-orange indicators and tabular or mono numbers.

properties.label: Controls drive a visible local model
properties.text: Excitation, damping and angle update the visible local model and curve; illumination and character controls expose actual state changes. Every control has native keyboard input.

properties.label: Local study, not industrial telemetry
properties.text: This is an interactive local study, not a connected industrial controller. Do not imply live equipment or measured external telemetry.

properties.label: Working control and graph check
properties.text: Reject decorative nonworking knobs. Verify values and graph response, selected state, contrast and complete mobile control coverage while keeping labels readable.
